title: UserSettingsDialog
description: Fiori user settings with responsive category navigation and composable settings views.

usage.summary: Let users inspect their account and review or change settings in categories.
useWhen: Group several user preferences by category and keep their settings in the same dialog.
Open the preferences from a Settings action in UserMenu.

avoidWhen.when: Show account information alongside sign-out and other short actions.
Ask the user to confirm one independent operation.
